thread.title: Apple Working On High-End Headphones: Report - Barron's

author: Jon Swartz
title: Apple Working On High-End Headphones: Report - Barron's

organizations.name: buffett laments high price of acquisitions apple

text:
(Photo by Justin Sullivan/Getty Images) Illustration: Getty Images Apple (ticker: AAPL) is readying high-quality over-the-ears headphones and updating its wireless AirPods, according to a report .
KGI Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo says the headphones could arrive as early as this year, according to Apple Insider . They are expected to be more expensive than AirPods, which retail for $159.
Apple reportedly is working on upgrades to AirPods that include the ability to activate Siri by voice and water resistance.
The addition of high-end headphones would round out Apple's product line. Apple already owns Beats Music and Beats Electronics , which it acquired for $3 billion in 2014.
